choice_policy.coin_payment: Use selected stat coin balance. The negotiation discount remains nested within C1 and must change both required balance and actual deduction.
choice_policy.insufficient_coins: If selected coin balance is below fee, show COIN_SHORTAGE message and return to the same four choices. Never apply a negative balance or block other choices.
choice_policy.minigame: Only duel and gambling. No reaction, memory, puzzle, race or other minigame types.
choice_policy.requirement: Use a probability roll computed from the CURRENT player stats when the option is attempted. No guaranteed success from simply waiting.
choice_policy.shortcut: Log mention only. Do not move player, create path, unlock next story, grant entry, or change stats. Return to choice menu.

requirement_probability.retry: Check CURRENT stats and roll again on each retry; collector time keeps moving and growth stays paused for the duration of the task.
requirement_probability.notes_ko: 요구사항은 플레이어가 보유한 현재 스탯으로 성공 확률을 매번 계산한다. 초기 5/5/5/5는 설명용이며 도중에 능력치가 바뀌면 확률도 즉시 바뀐다. 시도 시간 동안 징수원은 접근하고 능력치 성장은 멈춘다.

duel.lose_result: apply mini_game.failure then allow other options/retry
duel.notes_ko: 결투만 허용. 별도 퍼즐·반응형 게임 구현 금지.

gambling.lose_result: apply mini_game.failure then allow other options/retry
gambling.notes_ko: 지금은 앞면/뒷면 동전 내기만 구현. 능력 코인과는 별개인 확률 게임.

shortcut.notes_ko: 현재 샛길은 로그에만 언급. 실제 이동, 씬 전환, 해금, 통행 대체 처리하지 말 것.

structure.npc_and_location_definitions: Provided NPC관계.zip is authoritative; not duplicated in story data.
